reconciliationSummary: v0.4 Factory Lite Core is a PROCESS INTEGRITY LAYER that provides audit trail, contamination control, anti-gaming, and evidence discipline. Its effect on PRODUCT QUALITY is CONDITIONAL — it helped in EVAL-8 (+8) but did not help in EVAL-13 (-4). The net evidence across two benchmarks is MIXED and INCONCLUSIVE for product quality claims. The process-integrity benefits are consistent across both benchmarks.

benchmarks.interpretation: v0.4 Factory Lite showed real quality improvement on first benchmark. Key gains: test coverage, UI, code structure.
v0.4 Factory Lite did NOT show quality improvement on second benchmark. Scores effectively identical when controlling for UI. Verdict: INCONCLUSIVE.
benchmarks.result: Vanilla 99 > v0.4 Factory Lite 95 (-4). Gap from UI depth. Without UI: 94 vs 93.

title: v0.4 Evidence Reconciliation — EVAL-8 + EVAL-13

supported: v0.4 Factory Lite CAN improve product quality in at least one benchmark (EVAL-8: +8 points)
Manual Router and Proof-of-Read improve process traceability and audit trail
Contamination logging maintains benchmark integrity across runs
Evidence hierarchy prevents process artifacts from being counted as product quality
Anti-gaming controls prevent score inflation from fake tests/placeholders
Factory Lite Core has lower overhead (~200-375ms) than 10-role model (~1555ms)
10-role model is not justified as default (EVAL-8 confirmed underperformance)
Required-Reading Gate ensures spec is read before implementation
